author: North American House Hippo
text:
A gender-confused YouTube train foamer was bragging about how Ed Markey had a plan to spend hundreds of billions of dollars on Amtrak, but those plans were in peril with Mr. Trump's election.
Since the little gerbil enthusiast included a flattering picture with Senator Markey, I asked him if it irritated him that so many billions - even trillions - of dollars had been pissed away on foreign countries like The Ukraine and on a runaway military industrial complex, to say nothing of the astounding level of corruption of the foamer's home city, the District of Criminals. We have to struggle to have a tiny fraction of a fraction of our tax dollars spent on us, while money is sent to corrupt overseas boondoggles without a second thought.
Needless to say, he didn't take it well.
